title: Mayer--Vietoris gluing of canonical flat cohomology comparisons
statement: Let R,S be commutative rings with S a flat R-algebra [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map], f:X→Spec R a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], M a quasi-coherent O_X-module [pqf-def-coherent], and U,V open subschemes covering X. Use Ext-based cohomology [pqf-def-cohomology], scheme and module pullback [def-pc-base-change], and the canonical comparisons β of [def-pc-flat-cohomology-comparison]. Assume for every n≥0 that the comparisons on U, V, and U∩V for the restrictions of M are bijective. Then β^q_{f,M,S} on X is bijective for every q≥0. Neither the opens nor their intersection are assumed affine, compact, or separated. All local comparisons are the canonical maps, transported through the usual iterated-pullback isomorphisms.

source.place: Cohomology of Schemes, Lemma 30.5.2 (Tag 02KH), proof, quasi-separated-case paragraph: Mayer--Vietoris and induction on the number of affine opens

proof.text: Form the Mayer--Vietoris sequences for the two-open cover of X and its inverse-image cover of X_S. Tensor the first sequence with S; flatness preserves exactness and tensor preserves binary sums.

The specifically defined β maps give a commuting diagram of these sequences. Compatibility with restrictions is functoriality of the inverse-image Ext map and adjunction units. For the boundaries use naturality of Ext Yoneda composition, or a common Cech/injective double complex. Iterated-pullback isomorphisms identify the local maps with precisely those in the hypotheses.

In positive degree, the four outside arrows around the cohomology of X are isomorphisms by the assumptions in adjacent degrees. The five lemma proves the middle arrow bijective. In degree zero use the initial left-exact sequence starting with zero. This proves all degrees without assuming affine intersections.

lean.statement:
theorem H.baseChange_bijective_of_openCover
    {R S : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [Algebra R S] [Module.Flat R S]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) (M : X.Modules) [M.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U V : X.Opens) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    (hU : ∀ q : ℕ, Function.Bijective
      (H.baseChange (S := S) (U.ι ≫ f) ((pullback U.ι).obj M) q))
    (hV : ∀ q : ℕ, Function.Bijective
      (H.baseChange (S := S) (V.ι ≫ f) ((pullback V.ι).obj M) q))
    (hUV : ∀ q : ℕ, Function.Bijective
      (H.baseChange (S := S) ((U ⊓ V).ι ≫ f) ((pullback (U ⊓ V).ι).obj M) q))
    (q : ℕ) : Function.Bijective (H.baseChange (S := S) f M q)
